text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho has arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган is even more
enthusiastic than
usual, determined to
earn her place in the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now a "twinkly" racer that others are
desperate
to compete against, she steels
herself for the
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
